Self.Wiki: This map object represents a part within the map.

TypeIndex.Wiki: The index of a part amoungst all parts of the same model ID.

ModelName.Wiki: The model of the map object, corresponding to an entry in the ModelParam.

LayoutPath.Wiki: A path to a .sib file, presumed to be some kind of editor placeholder.

Rotation.Wiki: Rotation of the map object, in degrees.

Scale.Wiki: Scale of the map object, only meaningful for map pieces and objects.

LayerIndex.Wiki: The map layer (Layer list of the MSB) the map object belongs to, by index. -1 for none. Most parts use -1.

EntityID.Wiki: Identifies the map object in event scripts.

UsePartsDrawParamID.Wiki: If ON, the map object uses the Parts Draw Param ID row. Each draw flag below falls back to that row when its override is off.

PartsDrawParamID.Wiki: The PartsDrawParam row used when Use Parts Draw Param ID is on.

OverridePointLightShadowSrc.Wiki: If ON, Is Point Light Shadow Source is used instead of the draw param's isPointLightShadowSrc.

IsPointLightShadowSrc.Wiki: Whether the map object casts point light shadows. Only used when its override is ON.

OverrideDirLightShadowSrc.Wiki: If ON, Is Sun Shadow Source is used instead of the draw param's isDirLightShadowSrc (on by default). Set on about a third of retail assets.

IsDirLightShadowSrc.Wiki: Whether the map object casts the sun's (directional light's) shadow. Only used when its override is ON.

OverrideShadowDest.Wiki: If ON, Is Shadow Destination is used instead of the draw param's isShadowDst (on by default).

IsShadowDest.Wiki: Whether shadows fall on the map object. Only used when its override is ON.

OverrideShadowOnly.Wiki: If ON, Is Shadow Only is used instead of the draw param's isShadowOnly.

IsShadowOnly.Wiki: Whether the map object is only drawn into shadows. Only used when its override is ON.

OverrideDrawByReflectCam.Wiki: If ON, Is Drawn by Reflection Camera is used instead of the draw param's drawByReflectCam.

DrawByReflectCam.Wiki: Whether the map object is drawn by the reflection camera. Only used when its override is ON.

OverrideDrawOnlyReflectCam.AltName: Override: Only Drawn by Reflection Camera
OverrideDrawOnlyReflectCam.Wiki: If ON, Is Only Drawn by Reflection Camera is used instead of the draw param's drawOnlyReflectCam.

DrawOnlyReflectCam.AltName: Is Only Drawn by Reflection Camera
DrawOnlyReflectCam.Wiki: Whether the map object is only drawn by the reflection camera. Only used when its override is ON.

EntityGroupIDs.Wiki: The entity ID group this map object belongs to.

UnkE3C.Wiki: An ID, -1 when unused. Only set on assets (values such as 4, 100, 305, 400-437).

UnkE3E.Wiki: An unknown flag read by the game. Off on every retail map object.

DisableRTAO.Wiki: Disables ray traced ambient occlusion on this map object.

DisplayDataStruct.Wiki: The display and draw groups of the map object.

DisplayGroups.Wiki: For collisions: the groups shown while the player stands on it. Collisions also show their own draw groups.

DrawGroups.Wiki: The groups the map object belongs to: it is drawn while any of them is shown.

Struct50_UnkC0.Wiki: An unknown flag read by the game. On for 9 retail assets and 8 collisions.

Struct50_UnkC1.Wiki: If ON, an asset with a Display Group Source Part keeps its own display groups instead of taking that part's at map load. Off on every retail map object.

Struct50_UnkC2.Wiki: Read by the game. 0 on every retail map object.

Struct50_UnkC3.Wiki: Read by the game. 0 on every retail map object.

Struct50_UnkC4.Wiki: Read by the game. -1 on every retail map object.

DisplayStruct.Wiki: Display groups the collision adds to the ones shown while the player stands on it.

Condition.Wiki: A single display group (bit number) added to the groups below; -1 for none. Only set on collisions in m10_20_00_00 (10-40).

DispGroups.Wiki: The display groups added while the player stands on the collision.

LightId.Wiki: The ID of the value set from LightSet ParamEditor to use. -1 for none.

TransitionTime.Wiki: Amount of time it takes for GParam to transition (in seconds). -1 = Some default time.

GparamSubID_Base.Wiki: Not found read by the game; used by Smithbox's lighting preview to pick the GPARAM file.

GrassTypeParamIds.Wiki: The ID in GrassTypeParam determining properties of dynamic grass on a map piece.

EnemyStruct70_Unk00.Wiki: Read by the game. -1 for unused.

EnemyStruct70_Unk02.Wiki: Read by the game. -1 for unused.

EnemyStruct70_Unk04.Wiki: Read by the game. -1 for unused.

EnemyStruct70_Unk06.Wiki: Read by the game. -1 for unused.

EnemyStruct70_Unk08.Wiki: Read by the game. -1 for unused.

Struct88_Unk00.Wiki: An unknown flag read by the game. On for 90 retail assets and 25 enemies.

Struct88_Unk01.Wiki: An unknown flag read by the game. On for 27 retail assets.

Struct90_Unk00.Wiki: Read by the game. 0, 1 or 2 (assets and map pieces).
